The only pipeline in this RUN sends an echo-generated pinned SHA-256 record to sha256sum --check. The verifier is the last process and its failure stops the && chain; this is not a download-to-shell pipeline or a pipeline hiding a fetch failure.

This dependency-only component uses xorder’s observed APT_REFRESH package-index identity. Git is resolved from the current Debian feed and its installed package is confined to the build stage; Python and Serena payloads are copied into the final composition. Exact package version pins would bypass the existing observed-feed refresh contract.
